items.title: Star Veyland: a world with no edge
items.summary: Sea, rock and mountains are generated on your device from a seed and keep coming as you fly. The ship is a recipe of parts you can tune, and the whole scene is driven through MCP.
items.prompt: Create an infinite world in Polynite through MCP. Turn it on with scene.apply {op:'infinite', on:true, seed:7, follow:3}, then give it a ship recipe: {op:'infinite', ship_recipe:<JSON>} using the operators listed in polynite_capabilities.infinite_ship (loft, bore, planform, canopy, mount, neon; parts with hinges). Start from the linked scene's recipe and change its inputs with {op:'infinite', ship_params:{span:1.3, sweep:0.3, variety:1, seed:12}}.

items.title: An Endless Flight
items.summary: A ship skims an endless world that changes as it flies: open sea under red cliffs, plains, forests and mountains, mirrored in the water, all generated on your device from a seed and driven through MCP.
items.prompt: Create an endless flight in Polynite through MCP. Turn the infinite world on with scene.apply {op:'infinite', on:true, seed:7, follow:3}, hide the flat floor and keep a warm sky. Then shape it by name with the parameters listed in describe.infinite.params - oceans, rocky, water_reflect, boost, sparks - and add {op:'lens', on:true} for the sun. Use the linked scene as a starting point.

items.title: Cozy Autumn Night
items.summary: Polynite's complete demo: a stone cottage under the moon, volumetric light pouring from each window, a white garden lantern, a synthesised guitar score and a logo that dances to its notes. A perfect 15-second loop, generated on your device.
items.prompt: Create a cozy stone cottage in Polynite on a round wooden plinth: autumn maples, a full moon and ground mist. Give each window a warm spot light with volume above 0 and a portal, so light pours through the air as they switch on. Add a garden lantern whose glass glows with its own light. Write a guitar score in initial.music_notes, played by synthesised voices with no audio file, and make the logo dance to it with {op:'logo_fx', on:true, dance:1, beat:1}. Finish with a seamless loop. Use the linked scene as a starting point.

items.title: The mist keeper's refuge
items.summary: A small refuge, warm windows and drifting mist. Explore the scale, atmosphere and life around it.
items.prompt: Create a small timber refuge in Polynite on a stone foundation, with a steep roof, warm recessed windows, soft moonlight, drifting mist and small signs of life. Use the linked scene as a starting point and expose its building and atmosphere controls.

items.title: A house at the edge of dusk
items.summary: Timber, stone and a warm interior at dusk. Make your own version of the keeper's house.
items.prompt: Create a compact keeper's house in Polynite with timber, stone, a warm interior and a twilight garden. Preserve depth around the windows. Use the linked scene as a starting point, change its proportions and try another atmosphere.

items.title: The mill wakes with the light
items.summary: A mill in the first light, with moving details and a garden to explore.
items.prompt: Create a small stylised mill in Polynite with a timber building, a readable roof silhouette, moving mill details and a garden in soft dawn light. Start from the linked scene, keep it editable and expose the available building and atmosphere controls.

items.title: A pavilion that finds its footing
A garden made from shared tools

spotlight.title: Infinite worlds
spotlight.text: Fly in any direction and the world keeps going: sea, cliffs, forests and mountains, generated on your device from a seed. Change the seed for another world, or shape it through MCP.

collections.title: Infinite worlds
collections.pitch: Sea, cliffs, forests and mountains generated on your device from a seed. Keep flying: the world keeps coming.

collections.title: Cozy houses
collections.pitch: Warm windows, drifting mist and a little life around each house. Every one is a scene you can open and change.

collections.title: Landscapes that adapt
collections.pitch: Bridges, paths and gardens that read the ground under them. Change the land or a landing and the connections adapt.

collections.title: Buildings that connect
collections.pitch: Halls, galleries and gardens joined by real doorways and shared roofs. Each part stays editable while the link holds.

collections.title: Japanese gardens
collections.pitch: Ponds, bridges and tea houses, built from editable procedural recipes.

collections.title: Procedural workshop
collections.pitch: Facades, arcades and flowers: see how one recipe or one curve becomes a whole structure.
